notes.title: Castle of Delights – Artbook + OST – 50% Off
notes.notes:
[h2]The very essence of the Castle — its lines, its sounds, its secrets — is now yours.
The Artbook and Original Soundtrack for Castle of Delights are 50% off until June 2.[/h2]

The Artbook unveils what was never fully revealed: sketches, unfinished lines, sacred silhouettes, and the ritualistic process behind every chamber, every shadow, every forbidden door.

The Original Soundtrack carries the echo of the Castle — footsteps on marble, whispers behind locked doors, the pulse of seduction beneath high vaulted ceilings.
It’s a soundscape of longing, power, and surrender.

But even within these walls... a tremor begins.
A new fugue is forming.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827849/1f0bd4470416392b84d3acbe833c8d055ffc7c3d.png[/img]
It’s only a glimpse.
A fragment.
A sketch left behind in the making of something yet unnamed.

[h3]The Castle stands.
But the Dream shifts once more.[/h3]

Behind its gates, desire becomes ritual. Every corridor hides a trial, every chamber holds a secret.

Something new is coming.[/h3]

notes.title: Castle DLCs — Sound and Skin Preserved in Stillness (50% off)
notes.notes:
[i]Some echoes can’t be heard again.
Some images can’t be unseen.
But this week, both can be kept — at half their price.[/i]

 [h3]The Castle of Delights Original Soundtrack [/h3]is composed in full by the creator of the series. It’s a low-fi sonic ritual built from synthesized textures, ambient tones and emotional cadences — designed for oneiric immersion and private listening. These aren’t loops. They are memories.

[h3] The Official Artbook[/h3] brings you a silent gallery from the castle’s hidden halls.
Dozens of illustrations, character studies and alternate moments — including pieces that whisper of stories yet untold.

You’ll hear Vulpes fall silent behind a curtain.
You’ll see Zamora when she’s not speaking.
You’ll remember Elylah... before she knew what would come next.

 And you won’t be alone.

Nearly [h3]900 dreamers still have this Castle on their wishlist.[/h3]
Not all of them will enter.
But this week, you can.

A fugue is forming beyond these walls.
You may already feel it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827849/c588e62b68291d578c21f63368eb6984607a92f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Castle of Delights — Mirrors, Daemons and Desires (50% off)
notes.notes:
[i]Some places don’t trap you with walls.
They trap you with memories.[/i]

Castle of Delights is the second step in Elylah’s journey — a chapter of reverberations and emotional collision. The castle is not only a setting, but a mirror. And inside it, Elylah, Vulpes, and the Dreamer Zamora must each confront what they see… and what they hide.

[h3] The castle contains:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Forbidden baths and a monster of jelly

[*] Chambers filled with forgotten paintings — some prophetic

[*] The soft tension of women who want, but don't ask

[*] And the moment Nostalgia appears, without warning
[/list]

 This is the game where the world begins to shape itself.
Where the lore deepens. Where Elylah's voice grows.
And where your choices paint what cannot be unseen.

 [h2]This week, the Castle opens its doors at 50% off.[/h2]

[h3]Nearly 900 dreamers still wish to enter this castle.[/h3]
Their desire remains... unanswered.
[h3]Will you be the one to open the door?[/h3]

And just beyond these painted halls, something darker is tuning its strings.
[h3]A fugue is forming[/h3] — and Elylah will not descend alone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827849/794925c377bdcf350910907d99f8d250ca14d29d.png[/img]

 Also... For those who crave the art in stillness, [h3]a new illustrated codex is nearing completion.[/h3]

Take your time in the castle.
It will remember you.
